```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(trapezoid)
library(metafor)
```
Building the bias-adjustment function
```{r}
APP_FUN <- function(niter, RR, pD1E1, pD1E0, pD0E1, pD0E0, prD1, prD0, adj_OR) {
  
  #### CALCULATING BIASED OR ESTIMATE
  OR_b <- (pD1E1/pD1E0)/(pD0E1/pD0E0)
  bias_conf <- OR_b/adj_OR ## calculating bias due to confounding

  #### CALCULATING EXPECTED TOTAL ELIGIBLE NON-PARTICIPATING CASES/CONTROLS
  D1 <- round((pD1E1 + pD1E0)/prD1)
  D0 <- round((pD0E1 + pD0E0)/prD0)
  
  npD1 <- D1 - pD1E1 - pD1E0
  npD0 <- D0 - pD0E1 - pD0E0
  
  #### CALCULATING EXPOSURE PREVALENCE AMONG PARTICIPATING CASES
  prevE_p_D1 <- pD1E1/(pD1E1 + pD1E0)
  prevE_p_D0 <- pD0E1/(pD0E1 + pD0E0)
  
  #### DATA GENERATION FOR RANDOM TRAPEZOIDAL BIAS ADJUSTMENT (min = 0, max = 1)
  ## Exposure prevalence for non-participating cases
  expprev_np_D1_r1 <- rtrapezoid(niter,
                                 min = 0,
                                 mode1 = ifelse(prevE_p_D1 < prevE_p_D0, prevE_p_D1, prevE_p_D0),
                                 mode2 = ifelse(prevE_p_D0 > prevE_p_D1, prevE_p_D0, prevE_p_D1),
                                 max = 1)
  ## Exposure prevalence for non-participating controls
  expprev_np_D0_r1 <- rtrapezoid(niter,
                                 min = 0,
                                 mode1 = ifelse(prevE_p_D1 < prevE_p_D0, prevE_p_D1, prevE_p_D0),
                                 mode2 = ifelse(prevE_p_D0 > prevE_p_D1, prevE_p_D0, prevE_p_D1),
                                 max = 1)
  
  npD1E1_a <- rbinom(niter, npD1, expprev_np_D1_r1) ## Generating number of exposed cases
  npD1E0_a <- npD1 - npD1E1_a ## Generating number of unexposed cases
  npD0E1_a <- rbinom(niter, npD0, expprev_np_D0_r1) ## Generating number of exposed controls
  npD0E0_a <- npD0 - npD0E1_a ## Generating number of unexposed controls
  
  #### CALCULATING BIAS-ADJUSTED OR
  rannorm <- rnorm(niter, mean = 0, sd = 1) ## calculating random error
  OR_a <- ((pD1E1 + npD1E1_a) / (pD1E0 + npD1E0_a)) / ((pD0E1 + npD0E1_a) / (pD0E0 + npD0E0_a)) ## bias-adjusted estimate without considering random error or bias due to confounding
  L_SERR_a <- sqrt((1/(pD1E1))+(1/(pD1E0)) + (1/(pD0E1)) + (1/(pD0E0))) ## calculating standard error with random error
  OR_a2  <- (exp(log(OR_a)+(rannorm*L_SERR_a))) ## bias-adjusted estimate with random error
  OR_a3 <- OR_a2/bias_conf ## bias-adjusted estimate with random error and bias due to confounding

  ## SAVING RESULTS
  adj <- data.frame(OR_a3)

  return(list(adj = adj))
}
```
## Sandler et al. 1985
- Cases marginal participation = 60/76
- Controls marginal participation = 518/798
- Reported OR (manuscript) = 1.62
```{r}
set.seed(seed = 23) 
app_Sandler <- APP_FUN(niter = 100000, RR = 1.07,  pD1E1 = 19, pD1E0 = 13, pD0E1 = 76, pD0E0 = 101, prD1 = 60/76, prD0 = 518/798, adj_OR = 1.62)

Sandler_adj <- app_Sandler$adj

## bias-adjusted OR
summary(Sandler_adj$OR_a3) ## adjusting for confounding + random error
quantile(Sandler_adj$OR_a3, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
```

